description: The STREAM project deposits a community-battery state-of-charge series from its Spanish flexibility-market pilot. The public CC BY 4.0 Zenodo record lists one CSV of about 28 KB and names Time and SOC as its fields. The provider says the observations trained battery flexibility forecasts and optimisation algorithms for market participation and energy-cost reduction. A battery or local-grid simulation could use the sequence to compare state trajectories under alternative dispatch rules. It is a single pilot battery record, not a battery-chemistry performance model or a national storage benchmark. The page does not state SOC units or range, the date span, interval, usable capacity, degradation assumptions or missing-value handling. Those details matter before converting SOC differences into delivered energy. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this battery series. The CSV was not downloaded, so timestamps and SOC bounds have not been checked.
